observe.surface: the JSON a bin/lighthouse subcommand prints on stdout with its exit code, the files it writes in the results folder (suite.json, commits.json, retest.json, findings.json, verdict.json, report.md), and the verdict line and tool calls a lighthouse:test, lighthouse:init or lighthouse:doctor skill session produces
observe.value: specific JSON fields and exit codes (verdict, failures, unproven, flaky, tokens, minutes, suite result and classification, retest plan entries), the exact files written, and which skill or command a live claude -p session invoked
observe.observe_by: python3 bin/lighthouse <subcommand> in a scratch git repository built by tests/scratch.py, asserted by unittest; skills through claude -p with --plugin-dir pointing at the checkout, as tests/e2e_harness.py does
observe.terminal_action: lighthouse verdict writing verdict.json and printing the verdict line; lighthouse pr composing the FEATURE pull request; lighthouse profile publish committing the profile
observe.build_artifact: the checkout itself at the commit under test: lighthouse is pure Python run from bin/lighthouse with no build step, loaded as a Claude Code plugin from that folder
observe.twin: skills/test/SKILL.md re-states the rules lighthouse_tool/verdict.py, retest.py and suite.py enforce; README.md re-states the subcommand flags and verdict rules; the pipeline plugin's run skill re-states the verdict-line contract
observe.dependent: the pipeline plugin's Integration stage reads lighthouse:test's last stdout line (verdict, failures, unproven, flaky, tokens, minutes, pr) and passes --previous between runs; lighthouse:test calls every bin/lighthouse subcommand
observe.receipt: a unittest in tests/ that drives bin/lighthouse in a scratch repository and asserts the JSON and files, red on the base and green on the head; skill behaviour through the LIGHTHOUSE_E2E=1 end-to-end tests
observe.compat_boundary: the verdict-line JSON and the results-folder files (findings.json, retest.json, commits.json) read by the pipeline plugin and by later lighthouse runs through --previous, which can come from an older lighthouse version

reach.access: local only: python3 3.9+ and git on macOS or Linux; skills need the claude CLI signed in for claude -p
reach.shortcut: tests/scratch.py builds a scratch repository with a bare local remote, a temporary HOME and a stub gh, so no GitHub or credentials are needed
reach.fixtures: tests/fixtures/held-out holds the held-out fixture repositories the end-to-end harness builds; unit tests seed their own scratch repositories
reach.special_surfaces: skill behaviour (lighthouse:test, lighthouse:init, lighthouse:doctor) is observable only through a live claude -p session, which the end-to-end tests gate behind LIGHTHOUSE_E2E=1
